bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
printf 'STARTLESS_FINAL_READONLY\n'
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT state||'='||count(*) FROM startless_public_post_migrations GROUP BY state ORDER BY state;"
docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT kind||':'||state||'='||count(*) FROM startless_public_post_migrations GROUP BY kind,state ORDER BY kind,state;"
test "$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM startless_public_post_migrations;")" = 95 || exit 60
printf 'PROFILE='; docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT count(*) FROM profile_publications WHERE status='published' AND message_id>0;"
printf 'BOT='; docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' deploy-gaybbs-1
printf 'USERBOT='; systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service
root="$HOME/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot"
for pair in '-1003847210571:1494' '-1003847210571:1604' '-1003770334893:1123' '-1002373696859:4629';do
 chat="${pair%%:*}";msg="${pair##*:}"
 set +e
 response="$(timeout 25s env PYTHONPATH="$root/scripts" python3 -B "$root/scripts/userbot_test_client.py" room_public_readback --chat-id "$chat" --message-id "$msg" 2>&1)"
 rc=$?
 set -e
 printf 'PROBE=%s RESULT=%d %s\n' "$pair" "$rc" "$(printf '%s' "$response" | grep -E 'USERBOT_TEST_(RESULT|ERROR)' | tr '\n' ' ' | cut -c1-180)"
done
echo NO_POST_MODIFICATION=PASS
